short: Prepares its tools: lookalike domains, servers, stolen access, malware.
analogy: Buys lock picks, forges a uniform and rents a getaway car.

solutionNotes.ti: Knows the groups’ domains, servers and tools before the attack — they can be blocked in advance.
solutionNotes.email: Blocks emails from new suspicious domains and spoofed addresses.
solutionNotes.awareness: Employees learn to recognize fake “recruiters,” “partners” and faked voices.
solutionNotes.ngfw: Blocks connections to known malicious infrastructure.
solutionNotes.mfa: A bought or stolen password doesn’t open access without the second factor.
solutionNotes.edr: Catches a new tool by its behavior, even if it isn’t in any database yet.
solutionNotes.ueba: Spots a login made with bought access — it differs from the person’s usual behavior.
